*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /opt/builder/app.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Small durable HTTP record service for the builder deployment slot."""
+
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from hashlib import sha256
+from pathlib import Path
+from tempfile import mkstemp
+from threading import Lock
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+import os
+
+
+HOST = "0.0.0.0"
+PORT = 8080
+DATA_DIR = Path("/var/lib/builder-app/records")
+DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+STORE_LOCK = Lock()
+
+
+def record_path(record_id: str) -> Path:
+    # Hashing keeps arbitrary URL ids out of the filesystem namespace.
+    name = sha256(record_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() + ".record"
+    return DATA_DIR / name
+
+
+def store_record(record_id: str, body: bytes) -> None:
+    destination = record_path(record_id)
+    fd, temporary_name = mkstemp(prefix=".record-", dir=DATA_DIR)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as temporary:
+            temporary.write(body)
+            temporary.flush()
+            os.fsync(temporary.fileno())
+        with STORE_LOCK:
+            os.replace(temporary_name, destination)
+            directory_fd = os.open(DATA_DIR, os.O_RDONLY)
+            try:
+                os.fsync(directory_fd)
+            finally:
+                os.close(directory_fd)
+    except Exception:
+        try:
+            os.unlink(temporary_name)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            pass
+        raise
+
+
+def load_record(record_id: str) -> bytes | None:
+    try:
+        with record_path(record_id).open("rb") as record:
+            return record.read()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return None
+
+
+class RecordHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+    def send_body(self, status: int, body: bytes) -> None:
+        self.send_response(status)
+        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+        self.end_headers()
+        if body:
+            self.wfile.write(body)
+
+    def parsed_record_id(self) -> str | None:
+        parts = urlsplit(self.path).path.split("/")
+        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[1] != "records" or not parts[2]:
+            return None
+        return unquote(parts[2])
+
+    def do_GET(self) -> None:
+        path = urlsplit(self.path).path
+        if path == "/health":
+            self.send_body(200, b"ready")
+            return
+
+        record_id = self.parsed_record_id()
+        if record_id is None:
+            self.send_body(404, b"")
+            return
+        body = load_record(record_id)
+        if body is None:
+            self.send_body(404, b"")
+            return
+        self.send_body(200, body)
+
+    def do_PUT(self) -> None:
+        record_id = self.parsed_record_id()
+        if record_id is None:
+            self.send_body(404, b"")
+            return
+
+        try:
+            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
+        except ValueError:
+            self.send_body(400, b"")
+            return
+        if length < 0 or self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"):
+            self.send_body(400, b"")
+            return
+
+        body = self.rfile.read(length)
+        store_record(record_id, body)
+        self.send_body(204, b"")
+
+    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: object) -> None:
+        # Keep normal request traffic out of the unit journal.
+        return
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), RecordHandler)
+    server.serve_forever()
*** End Patch
